review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: About the Role As Marosa's Systems Administrator (part of Wolters Kluwer’s Corporate Tax portfolio under the CP&ESG division), you’ll take full ownership of our internal IT: the systems, laptops, and software our team relies on every day to get work done. This is a practical, hands-on role focused on running our internal helpdesk, managing our Microsoft 365 environment, maintaining office equipment, and handling vendor contracts. Responsibilities IT Operations & Service Desk Manage day-to-day IT
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a practical, hands-on role focused on running our internal helpdesk, managing our Microsoft 365 environment, maintaining office equipment, and handling vendor contracts. Qualifications Education & Certifications Education: Degree or Higher Vocational Training (FP II / Grado Superior) in Computer Science, Systems Administration, Information Technology, or equivalent practical hands-on experience. 5+ years of hands-on experience Certifications (Nice to Have): Microsoft 365 Certified (Modern Desktop / Enterprise Administrator), Intune/Endpoint Administrator, or ITIL v4 Foundation. Hands-on expertise administering Microsoft 365 (Teams, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Entra ID / Azure AD) and endpoint management via Microsoft Intune.
